subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub preserve a supported post-publish GitHub Release repair path, or intentionally retire it and own a documented manual recovery procedure?
rationale: The patch removes an established release fallback, and only release-automation owners can decide whether that operational capability remains required.

options.title: Preserve repair automation
options.body: Keep the workflow or replace it with an equivalent repair-only mode before merging this cleanup.

options.title: Retire with manual recovery
options.body: Remove the workflow only after documenting and proving a safe procedure for rebuilding the GitHub Release from the published npm artifact.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Leave the current workflow and runbook intact until release owners exercise and approve a replacement path.

recommendation.title: Preserve repair automation
recommendation.body: Keep the workflow or replace it with an equivalent repair-only mode before merging this cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced and most recently maintained the exact release-repair surface under review.
